items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: in later years I told the story to Jimmy Heath and he said to me, “Oh you’d never have seen that again.”

ctx.x: You passed? I think I would too.
Well Ronnie Scott wound up lending him a horn you know, but in later years I told the story to Jimmy Heath and he said to me, “Oh you’d never have seen that again.”
It would have found its way to a pawn shop, ey?
